description: Reads one collection: its settings (name, singular, plural, URL folder, sort), groups, every field with its type, rules and options, the collection page settings (SEO and share templates, JSON-LD, custom code), the item count, the CMS kit state and the collection page (file, route, whether it exists and is routed), and how each field type's value is written. Read it before writing items or binding a page. Reads only.

branch.description: Optional branch; default the branch the workspace has open

collection.description: The collection id (its folder under content/), from list_collections

name: get_collection
title: Get a CMS collection
